papers.title: High-Frequency Ultrasonic Impact Treatment Effect on Fatigue Properties of TC4 Titanium Alloy Laser Wire Filling-Welded Joints
papers.abstract: This study aimed to improve the fatigue properties of TC4 titanium alloy laser-filled wire welded joints. To this end, the highfrequency ultrasonic impact technology (UIT) was used to implement post-weld impact treatment on the welded part. Nondestructive testing of the phase composition, microstructure, microhardness, static and cyclic tensile properties, and fracture morphology before and after UIT were conducted and comparatively analyzed. The results show that the high-frequency UIT refines surface grains without affecting the weld phase composition, which is still dominated by the martensitic α' phase and does not form the ω phase. Due to plastic slip-induced strain-hardening, the microhardness of the weld surface layer is about 12% higher than before the UIT and about 40% higher than that of the base metal. Before UIT, long and thick cracks at static tensile fracture extend on the specimen surface; after UIT, the static tensile fracture surface is fine and smooth, and tiny cracks expand in the interior. The fatigue limit of the laser wire filling welding (LWFW) in the TC4 titanium alloy joint increased by about 29.4% after UIT. After high-frequency ultrasonic impact, cracks expand in the joint; the fatigue band spacing becomes smaller, and dimples are denser and deeper, while the fatigue limit load increases, effectively improving the fatigue resistance of the TC4 titanium alloy laser wire-filling welded joint.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是TC4钛合金激光填丝焊接接头的超声冲击处理，并非增材制造（LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED）Ti-6Al-4V，因此不属于本方向关注的核心内容。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on laser wire filling welded joints and post-weld ultrasonic impact treatment, not on additively manufactured (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED) Ti-6Al-4V mechanical or fatigue performance; thus it does not meet the direction's requirement for an AM process.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高TC4钛合金激光填丝焊接接头的疲劳性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用高频超声冲击技术对焊后接头进行处理，并进行微观结构、硬度、拉伸和疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 超声冲击后疲劳极限提高约29.4%，表面晶粒细化，硬度提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验对比处理前后的微观组织、力学性能和断口形貌验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the fatigue properties of TC4 titanium alloy laser wire filling welded joints.
summary_en.method: High-frequency ultrasonic impact treatment (UIT) was applied post-weld, followed by nondestructive testing of phase composition, microstructure, microhardness, static and cyclic tensile properties, and fracture morphology.
summary_en.result: UIT increased the fatigue limit by about 29.4%, refined surface grains, and raised surface microhardness by about 12%.
summary_en.validation: Comparative experimental analysis of microstructural, mechanical, and fractographic features before and after UIT confirmed the improvements.
